item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
p=Path('caught-up.svg')
r=ET.parse(p).getroot()
ns={'s':'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'}
assert r.find('s:title',ns).text == \"You're all caught up\"
style=r.find('s:style',ns).text
assert 'prefers-reduced-motion: reduce' in style
assert '0%, 25%, 75%, 100%' in style
assert '8s ease-in-out infinite' in style
assert not r.findall('.//s:script',ns)
print(f'{p}: valid XML, {p.stat().st_size} bytes; loop and reduced-motion styles present.')
PY"
